note: _et faciet omnes pusillos et magnos_ (…) _habere characterem in dextera manu sua_ – and he shall make all, little and great (…) to have a character in their right hand (Douay Version). On _character_ = brand [Mal], see Richards, p. 17: “being literally in use for recruits to the army from about A.D. 350, applied by St Augustina to the indelible ‘character’ of baptism and orders.”
